name: gi-company-accounts-and-reporting
description: Gibraltar private mainstream company accounts and reporting reference covering books, accounting frameworks, company size, audit conditions, signed filings, annual returns, group consolidation and exemption conditions, and late filing charges. Includes two-of-three classification and tax audit boundary examples. Checked against the Companies Act consolidation dated August 2025 and Income Tax Act consolidation dated March 2026. Explicitly distinguishes turnover, assessable income and filing deadlines, with a stale audit-exemption cross-reference identified for legal review. This research draft is not accountant-attested.
